The Problem: The Costly Planning Gap

Between your SAP system and your actual supply chain decisions lies a massive gap. Right now, your team fills that gap by stitching together data by hand. When you supply multiple OEMs, manual planning breaks down.

Mismatched Data

Every customer sends demand in different formats, cadences, and time horizons.

High-SKU Complexity

Managing thousands of part-customer-plant combinations crashes traditional spreadsheets.

Constant Fire Drills

Unflagged demand shifts and missing data cause severe schedule volatility.
